headline: BMS doubles down on AI drug discovery after three year evaluation
body: Bristol Myers Squibb completed a three-year assessment of AI-driven drug discovery and committed additional resources to expand the program. This signals confidence in AI's ability to accelerate early-stage research and reduce time-to-candidate identification. For healthcare AI, the validation matters because it demonstrates that enterprise pharma sees measurable ROI from AI workflows in discovery, potentially reshaping how vendors approach clinical research informatics and drug development pipelines. The commitment suggests similar evaluations are underway at competing pharma companies, creating near-term demand for AI platforms that integrate with existing R&D infrastructure.
